NBL Championship Series Game 5: Illawarra Hawks v Melbourne United at WIN Entertainment Centre. Tip-off at 2.30pm, full time around 4.30pm.

Traffic will be heavier than usual as fans travel to and from the match.

Allow extra travel time on roads including Burelli St, Corrimal St, Stewart St and Crown St.

Fans driving to the game on the freeway are encouraged to use the Masters Rd exit to avoid congestion at Mount Ousley Rd, both in and out of Wollongong.

Allow extra travel time for parking and be aware of increased pedestrian activity on local roads.
